proposition: Pīr-Muḥammad was murdered in 812/1409; his brother Iskandar Mīrzā took his place in Shiraz and soon established a brilliant court in Isfahan (timeline: 815-17/1412-14).

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Maṣdūr II, as MK cites it in a note
mediation.note: the detail is his own telling, in an apology to a ruler
